A '''targeting sensor''', also known as a '''Target-Acquiring Sensor'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], generally mounted on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as part of the vessel's targeting package. It could be installed into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] chassis.

Targeting sensors aboard the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] could track up to one thousand moving sublight objects and acquire up to twenty bogeys simultaneously. At the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] command, the targeting sensors transferred data to the [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] via a [[shielded circuit multiplexer]].<ref name="RPG" />

[[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation's]] [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 P-Tower]] had its targeting sensors located at the apex of the high energy dish.<ref name="EGWT" />
